scholarships.name: Bachelor's Academic Merit Scholarship
scholarships.description: Tuition discount of 15%, 25% or 50% per trimester for new bachelor's students who meet academic grade thresholds (IB 30/35/40, A-levels, CBSE).
scholarships.descriptionRu: Скидка на tuition 15%, 25% или 50% за триместр для новых студентов bachelor's, удовлетворяющих академическим порогам (IB 30/35/40, A-levels, CBSE).

scholarships.name: Master's Academic Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based tuition discount of 15% or 25% for postgraduate students with GPA 3.0+.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Merit-скидка 15% или 25% от tuition для postgraduate-студентов с GPA 3.0+.

scholarships.name: Adam Gilchrist Sports Scholarship
scholarships.description: 50% tuition bursary for outstanding sports achievement (named after Australian cricketer Adam Gilchrist AM); two recipients annually at bachelor or master level.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Bursary 50% от tuition за outstanding спортивные достижения (имени крикетиста Adam Gilchrist AM); 2 получателя в год на bachelor или master.

scholarships.name: Continuing Students Scholarship
scholarships.description: Tuition discount for continuing bachelor's and master's students who maintain academic performance.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Скидка на tuition для продолжающих bachelor's и master's студентов, поддерживающих академический уровень.

scholarships.name: IHC International Cooperation Award (MIR)
scholarships.description: Merit award for Master of International Relations applicants based on a 2,000-word project on UAE international cooperation, evaluated by the IHC.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Merit-стипендия для абитуриентов Master of International Relations на основе проекта 2,000 слов по международному сотрудничеству ОАЭ, оценка IHC.

accommodation.name: The Myriad Dubai (DIAC)
accommodation.text: Recommended student residence в Dubai International Academic City — studio и shared rooms, рядом с университетами DIAC.

accommodation.name: Off-campus Al Barsha / Knowledge Village area
accommodation.text: Apartments и shared rooms в Al Barsha — 10-20 минут до UOWD Knowledge Village campus.

accommodation.name: Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) shared accommodation
accommodation.text: Студенческое housing в DSO и Discovery Gardens — bed space и shared rooms для студентов с ограниченным бюджетом.

accommodation.name: Jebel Ali Gardens (historical UOWD residence area)
accommodation.text: Resident area в Jebel Ali Gardens — ~15 минут до campus, традиционная зона размещения UOWD-студентов.

campuses.title: Dubai Knowledge Park Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус UOWD в Dubai Knowledge Park — administrative facilities, library, faculty offices, computer labs, student services. Все Bachelor's, Master's и PhD программы.

campuses.title: UOWD Abu Dhabi Campus
campuses.text: Кампус в Abu Dhabi для расширения присутствия UOWD в столице — Open Day программы и постепенное расширение academic offer.

paragraphs: The University of Wollongong in Dubai (UOWD) is the first international Australian university in the United Arab Emirates, established in 1993 as the Institute of Australian Studies and incorporated under its current name in 2004. UOWD is part of the global University of Wollongong (UOW) brand, with sister campuses in Australia, Hong Kong and Malaysia, and ranks among the top 1% of universities worldwide in the QS World University Rankings 2024.

All UOWD degrees are issued by University of Wollongong Australia and are accredited by the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), licensed by KHDA, and audited by Australia's Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Agency (TEQSA). Additional professional accreditations include ACCA, CIM and CIMA. Every UOWD academic holds a PhD from a top-ranked international university.

The main campus is located in Dubai Knowledge Park, with student residences historically clustered in Jebel Ali Gardens about 15 minutes from campus. UOWD serves over 5,000 students from 108 countries across more than 40 internationally accredited degrees in 10 industry sectors — Business, Engineering, ICT, Healthcare, Communications and Media, Psychology and more — and recently launched Master of Applied Cybersecurity and Master of Applied Artificial Intelligence.

UOWD's global alumni network spans more than 152,000 working professionals, and 85% of graduates are employed within six months of graduation (Graduate Destination Survey 2017-2023). Students enjoy borderless mobility to UOW campuses in Australia, Hong Kong and Malaysia.
paragraphsRu: University of Wollongong in Dubai (UOWD) — первый международный австралийский университет в ОАЭ, основан в 1993 как Institute of Australian Studies и инкорпорирован под текущим именем в 2004. UOWD входит в глобальный бренд University of Wollongong (UOW) с кампусами в Австралии, Hong Kong и Malaysia, и входит в top 1% университетов мира по QS World University Rankings 2024.

Все дипломы UOWD выдаются University of Wollongong Australia и аккредитованы UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), лицензированы KHDA и аудируются Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Agency (TEQSA) в Австралии. Дополнительные профессиональные аккредитации — ACCA, CIM и CIMA. Все преподаватели UOWD имеют PhD из топовых международных университетов.

Главный кампус расположен в Dubai Knowledge Park, студенческие residences исторически сосредоточены в Jebel Ali Gardens в 15 минутах от кампуса. UOWD обучает более 5,000 студентов из 108 стран на 40+ международно аккредитованных программах в 10 индустриальных секторах — Business, Engineering, ICT, Healthcare, Communications and Media, Psychology и др., — и недавно запустил Master of Applied Cybersecurity и Master of Applied Artificial Intelligence.

Глобальная сеть выпускников UOWD насчитывает более 152,000 working professionals, 85% выпускников трудоустраиваются в течение 6 месяцев после выпуска (Graduate Destination Survey 2017-2023). Студенты получают borderless mobility между кампусами UOW в Australia, Hong Kong и Malaysia.
